question: _______ is celebrated as Gujarati New Year in India.
solution: The correct answer is __Bestu Varsh__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Gujarati New Year or Bestu Varsh was celebrated on 26 October 2022. • The Gujarati New Year is also known as Vikram Sanvat 2079. • Homes are decorated with Asopalav torans and marigold flowers. • On this auspicious day, businessmen and traders start their new account books after closing the old ones.
